newsitem.title: USA: Amerin expects more captive regulations.
newsitem.headline: Amerin expects more captive regulations.

text.p: Amerin Corp said Thursday it expects the New York State Insurance Department to issue more regulations on captive mortgage reinsuring, but it is continuing to insure loans under its plan.

Amerin said it received a letter from the department on March 20, which said its general counsel believed the captive reinsurance structure violated New York State insurance law. It then began talks with the department.

"As a result of this dialogue, the department is aware of, and does not object to, our plan to continue insuring loans under our existing captives and to close a number of captives already in development," chairman and chief executive Gerald Friedman said in a statement, adding the company is expecting more department guidelines and regulations.
"Going forward, we're confident that we will be able to work with the department to create a framework in which captive reinsurance can flourish," Friedman said.
Amerin provides private mortgage insurance to mortgage originators. It said it pioneered captive mortgage reinsurance.
On Thursday, Amerin reported first quarter earnings of $0.33 a share versus $0.22 last year.
Friedman said earnings were on track for the quarter and the company's market share increased.
